description: archive_logs() builds a shell command by string interpolation — a hostile filename injects commands. Rewrite it to use subprocess with an argv list (shell=False), and validate the name BEFORE touching the filesystem: only [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]* ending in .log is allowed; anything else (injection strings, path separators, dash-lead, or a safe name that does not exist) raises ValueError.
